title: Earn 20x Everyday Rewards Points on Apple Gift Cards (Max 10 Cards Per Day, In-Store Only) @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: Earn 20x Everyday Rewards Points on Apple Gift Cards (Max 10 Cards Per Day, In-Store Only) @ Woolworths

[catbin] With the current situation, it’s really not worth the hassle.
You are NOT SAFE even if the card appears untouched. Someone might have captured images/codes in the printing factory before it seals.
Bought a $500 one last Tuesday. Activation was successful, giftcard package intact, seal intact, scratch covering intact, code intact. Couldn’t redeem. Called apple, provided the gift card serial number. they said the card had been blocked 16 hours before I made the purchase due to a suspected fraud activity. Apple won’t replace the giftcard as it has been flagged. I returned to Woolworths, but they declined to act immediately, even with the Apple support person on the line. Photos taken with apple support’s email confirming it’s a blocked gift card. Left contact details, emailed Woolworths gift card department, no updates.
Whoever held the code attempted redemption before it’s funded. That’s how this card was flagged. The next customer might not be lucky. They know which batch of cards were sent to Woolworths and plan to test the codes during or immediately after the promotion to get big fish.
[frewer] This's wild, can you log a complaint to accc or ombudsman?? I know in Australia the big brother don't want to upset the big corp ( not even tax them properly), but this is nut
[hihi] Add to that, Apple makes you want to use the giftcards. You cant click and collect anything in store and shipping will be longer than pay with cards
[quick-dry] what error message does it give on failure to redeem? is it the same as if you manually entered the wrong code or something else?
[catbin] Card not valid. It’s a flagged gift card. They even told me when the card was voided.
[blueberrybear] I’ve utilised this promo in the past.
But doubt I will again given all the bs with Woolworths gift cards, Apple gift cards, and other gift cards going around, and coming to light.
Great bargain in principle.
Not worth the risk whatsoever imho.
[redhaze1] Awesome! That'll help when the 'ATO' calls and threatens to arrest me if I don't pay my outstanding tax bill with Apple gift cards.
[jasiano] I bought $600 of Apple Card’s last week on the previous promo, had no issues with any of them.
Before that, I had stocked up about $1k worth over the previous couple of promos - no issues.
It’s wild (to me) that so many people have encountered dodgy cards.
[NPB] Same, I have bought from Coles and WW so many times and been lucky not to have issues.
[YesPleaseThankYou] It’s wild (to me) that so many people have encountered dodgy cards.
It might be wild to you but as someone who has purchased many $1000s of worth of these cards, and someone who is wise to the scams, it has also happened to me.
You have been lucky. Stay vigilant!
[rafasaur] 3 months ish ago i purchased 3grand worth, no issues with them. So I do find it surprising.
[the fig man] I bought 3x Apple GCs for family for xmas… checked they weren't tampered with in store. Now i'm paranoid they've already been hacked.
